mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.25 percentage point increase in the federal funds rate over a 3-month period signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate reduces real equity valuations due to higher real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
